rationale: Proposed splitting the work into a deterministic domain core (kg-build-system plus a JSON CLI), a thin plugin adapter (tools, commands, context injection, permissions) and OpenCode as the harness owning the loop, sessions and approvals. The hard constraint is that the model may only assert what a tool returned, so every number, edge and audit finding comes from the domain core rather than generated prose. The first increment was kgctl validate/build/audit plus three tools, the /kg-build command, an agent profile and an authoring skill.
subject: P-2
title: Ship a domain capability and agent profile on an existing harness, not a new agent
